1.w: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. In You, O YHWH, I have taken refuge; do not let me be ashamed forever; in Your righteousness, deliver me!

2.w: Incline Your ear to me, and quickly deliver me. Be for me as a rock of refuge, as a house of strongholds to save me.

3.w: For You [are] my rock and my stronghold; and for the sake of Your name, You will lead me and guide me.

4.w: You will bring me out from the net that they have hidden for me, because You [are] my refuge.

5.w: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O YHWH, God of truth.

6.w: I have hated those serving worthless idols; and I toward YHWH place my trust.

7.w: I will rejoice and be glad in Your loving devotion—in that You have seen my affliction, [and] you knew of the distress of my soul.

8.w: And You did not shut me up in the hand of the enemy, You set my feet on a broad place.

9.w: Show favor to me, O YHWH, for there is distress for me! My eye, my soul, and my belly have wasted away with grief.

10.w: For my life has been consumed with grief, and my years with groaning; my strength fails in my iniquity, and my bones are wasting away.

11.w: Among all my enemies I am an object of scorn, even to my neighbors, and a source of dread, exceedingly to those who know me; those seeing me in the street flee from me!

12.w: I have been forgotten like a dead man from the heart; I am perishing like a vessel.

13.w: For I have heard the slander of many, terror from round about, in their taking counsel together against me; they have plotted to take my life.

14.w: Yet I have trusted in You, O YHWH; I say, “You [are] My God.”

15.w: In Your hand [are] my times; deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those pursuing me.

16.w: Cause Your face to shine upon Your servant; save me in Your loving devotion.

17.w: O YHWH, do not let me be ashamed, for I have called to You. Let the wicked be ashamed; let them be silent in Sheol.

18.w: Let the lips of falsehood become dumb, those speaking against the righteous [with] arrogance, with pride and contempt.

19.w: How great [is] Your goodness, which You have laid up for those fearing You, [which] you have prepared for those taking refuge in You before the sons of man!

20.w: You shall hide them in the hidden place of Your presence, from the plots of man; you shall store them in a shelter, from the strife of tongues.

21.w: Blessed [be] YHWH, for He has made marvelous His loving devotion to me, in a city [under] siege.

22.w: For I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before Your eyes!” Surely You heard the voice of my supplications, in my crying out to You.

23.w: Love YHWH, all you His holy ones! YHWH is watching the faithful and recompensing the worker of pride in excess.

24.w: Hold firm, and He shall strengthen your⁺ heart, all those waiting for YHWH.
